description: Founded in 2011, CrowdStrike reinvented cybersecurity for the cloud and artificial intelligence era and transformed the way cybersecurity is delivered and experienced by customers. It took a fundamentally different approach with the AI-native CrowdStrike Falcon cybersecurity platform, which serves as the operating system for cybersecurity, building the first true cloud-native platform with AI at the core, capable of harnessing vast amounts of security and enterprise data to drive real-time security decisions and response stopping breaches at scale through a single lightweight sensor, and the platform is designed to be the definitive platform for cybersecurity consolidation, purpose-built to stop breaches.
